_doc: Tunables for src-tauri/src/clipboard.rs's clipboard-manager tray (a native ksni tray, NOT config-driven like systrays.json — see that file's top-level comment and clipboard.rs's module doc for why). build.sh install copies this to ~/.local/share/my-konsole/clipboard.json; edits apply on the next --tray-daemon restart, no rebuild needed. `default_lists` only SEEDS empty named lists on first run (or if a name is added here later) — lists are otherwise created at runtime via the tray's Lists ▸ New list… menu action, and both paths write to the same runtime store (clipboard-store.json), never here.
